capabilities: Find and replace text in the current note
Toggle match case, whole word and regular expression matching
Move, resize and collapse the floating widget
Highlight and navigate matches in reading view
Use VS Code keybindings for find, replace and toggles
disambiguation: Not a VS Code integration; it only brings VS Code's find-and-replace widget style into Obsidian.
extras: Warns users to remove the built-in hotkey binding when assigning the same key, otherwise Obsidian runs whichever command it finds first.
problem: Obsidian's built-in in-file find and replace lacks a floating overlay, regex/word toggles, and VS Code keyboard shortcuts.

relations.evidence: Based on Enhanced search and replace by Liu Hao (Apache-2.0).

summary: VS Code style find-and-replace widget that floats over the editor with match case, whole word and regex toggles.
